title: How Beavers Reshape Entire River Ecosystems
hook: Beavers transform rivers and shape freshwater environments.

scenes.narration: In Europe, beavers were reduced to fragmented populations, with combined population numbers being estimated at 1,200 individuals.
These remaining groups survived in the Rhône of France, the Elbe in Germany, southern Norway, and Belarus.
Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds across these regions.
The concept became popular in conservation, and was deployed in a range of contexts to engender support.
This framework was mobilized where human activities had damaged ecosystems, such as by removing keystone predators.
In addition, wolves often kept animals from grazing in riparian areas, which protected beavers from food encroachment.
The connectivity of streams to their adjacent floodplain along their entire length plays an important role.
Stream restoration or river restoration is a set of activities that aim to improve the environmental health.
